title: First-use walkthrough
subtitle: From first launch to a room-ready End User Interface.

steps.title: Review privacy
steps.body: Select Get Started. Configuration stays on this Android device, and credentials are encrypted locally.

steps.title: Find a driver
steps.body: Search by manufacturer or model, review the driver, then select + to create a connection.

steps.title: Connect and test
steps.body: Enter the address and port, connect, then send a safe command. Successful changes save automatically.

steps.title: Review the room
steps.body: Check Power On and Power Off presets, Switching, and Audio. Test the actual equipment before handoff.

steps.title: Hand off simple control
steps.body: Open the EUI for system power, source routing, and the room audio controls supported by the configured devices.

steps.title: Return to setup
steps.body: Press and hold the upper-left CTRLbot control for two seconds. A quick tap intentionally does nothing.
